privileged.modules/client-actions/restricted-follow: After a restricted record's access change commits, in that event's org: runs kernel.restricted_access_follow again as a reconcile (it reads the record's stored list itself and sets it as visible_to on the client actions of the record and its versions, and owner-routes or cancels its pending approvals), announces the cancelled requests, and prunes that record's discussion to the person who changed it. Nothing is read beyond those rows.
